sources.entry: Crafty Controller - Minecraft launcher and manager that allows users to start and administer Minecraft servers from a user-friendly interface. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker/Python

summary.name: Crafty Controller
summary.one_liner: Crafty 4 is a Minecraft server wrapper, controller and launcher with a web interface for starting and administering Minecraft servers.
use_cases: run and manage Minecraft servers from a web interface
self-host a Minecraft server control panel
launch Minecraft servers without the command line
summary.what_it_does: ["Crafty 4 is described as the next iteration of a Minecraft server wrapper, controller and launcher, rebuilt from the ground up with a new look. The page is a GitLab repository browser showing branches and tags (latest listed tag is v4.11.0). The page text does not describe specific features in detail. An awesome-selfhosted listing describes it as a user-friendly interface for starting and administering Minecraft servers, licensed GPL-3.0 and written in Docker/Python."]
notable: Rebuilt from the ground up as Crafty 4 with a new look
Source code hosted on GitLab with tagged releases up to v4.11.0
caveats: Page text is mainly a repository file browser; detailed feature list not present
Page does not state supported operating systems
